commit 15612ba71e07b037dc36ed102ba276258615e762
Author:     Ikey Doherty <ikey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Jul 24 08:40:09 2024 +0000
Commit:     Ikey Doherty <ikey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Jul 24 08:40:09 2024 +0000

    Bug 1909485 - Install TB-Symbolic.svg to fix the sys_tray crate. r=heather,babolivier
    
    The daily builds don't ship the TB-Symbolic.svg asset, as a result
    without a working fallback the tray icon is broken on GNOME.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D217454

diff --git a/mail/installer/allowed-dupes.mn b/mail/installer/allowed-dupes.mn
index 6627eba26a0..f38e16663fc 100644
--- a/mail/installer/allowed-dupes.mn
+++ b/mail/installer/allowed-dupes.mn
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@ chrome/icons/default/default48.png
 chrome/icons/default/default64.png
 chrome/icons/default/default128.png
 chrome/icons/default/default256.png
+chrome/icons/default/TB-symbolic.svg
 
 #ifdef XP_MACOSX
 LaunchServices/org.mozilla.updater
diff --git a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
index 092ab076c9b..e67aa800dc8 100644
--- a/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
+++ b/mail/installer/package-manifest.in
@@ -204,6 +204,7 @@
 @RESPATH@/chrome/icons/default/calendar-general-dialog.ico
 #elifdef UNIX_BUT_NOT_MAC
 @RESPATH@/chrome/icons/default/*.png
+@RESPATH@/chrome/icons/default/*.svg
 #endif
 
 ; Gloda
